description: Photo and video gallery for CardputerZero

store.summary: Browse folders and view photos and videos with the arrow keys
store.description: Pick a folder and flip through its photos and videos full screen with the arrow keys (F/X/Z/C work with or without Fn). JPEG photos open natively with EXIF rotation; every other image format, animated GIFs and all videos are decoded by the system ffmpeg, with sound through PipeWire. ESC goes back, hold ESC to exit.
